title: Terminal Band
purpose: Collapsible terminal panel at the bottom showing terminal tabs and emulator
states: collapsed - band is closed showing only edge handle
open - band is open showing terminal tabs and emulator
maximized - band is taking full height with apps minimized below
acceptance: shall display terminal tabs grouped by session
shall show terminal emulator (xterm) for active tab
shall allow dragging divider to resize band height
shall support pull-up gesture to collapse when open
shall support drag-down gesture to expand when collapsed
shall display empty state when no terminals
shall allow splitting terminal into panes
shall show 'still running' confirmation when closing busy terminal
